fx_note.en: USD figures are approximate. They use the figure in the cited source where one is given; otherwise EUR is converted at about 1.13 and HKD at about 7.85 USD. Original currency is always shown.
fx_note.zh: 美元数字均为约数：来源给了美元就用来源的；没给的，欧元按约 1.13、港币按约 7.85 换算。原币金额始终保留。

en.title: Netherlands: AI-recorded fake bank calls cost about 170 victims €380,000
en.amount_note: About $430K · around 170 victims · about three weeks
en.summary: Victims heard a prerecorded warning about suspicious account activity. Police say the callers used AI to produce dozens of recordings with different voices and scenarios. Pressing 1 connected victims to a human posing as a bank employee, who had them install a fake banking app and hold their card to the phone. The app captured the card's NFC data, and an accomplice withdrew cash. Two suspects were arrested, and a Rotterdam court ordered them held for at least 90 more days. They have not been convicted.
en.takeaway: AI made the recordings, while people ran the live calls. Dutch police warn that a bank will never ask you to install an app during a call, hold your card to your phone, or share your PIN.
steps: AI-made recording warns of suspicious activity
Press 1 reaches a fake bank employee
Fake app reads the card over NFC
Accomplice withdraws the cash
en.human_role: AI made the recordings. People ran the live calls.

zh.title: 荷兰：AI 录音冒充银行来电，约 170 人被骗 €38 万
zh.amount_note: 约 $43 万 · 约 170 名受害者 · 约 3 周
zh.summary: 受害者先听到一段账户异常的录音。警方称，骗徒用 AI 制作了几十段不同声音、不同场景的录音。按 1 后转接到冒充银行员工的真人，对方让受害者安装假银行 App，再把银行卡贴在手机上。App 读取卡片的 NFC（近场通信）数据，同伙随即取现。警方逮捕 2 人，鹿特丹法院裁定继续羁押至少 90 天，两人尚未被定罪。
zh.takeaway: AI 负责录音，现场通话的是真人。荷兰警方提醒：银行不会要求你在通话中安装 App、把银行卡贴到手机上，或透露 PIN 码。
steps: AI 录音称账户异常
按 1 转接假银行员工
假 App 通过 NFC 读卡
同伙取现
zh.human_role: AI 制作录音，现场通话的是真人。

en.title: South Korea: seven financial firms breached in attacks linked to an AI pentest tool
en.amount_note: About 67,000–68,000 people affected at the first seven firms
en.summary: The first seven firms named were Shinhan Bank, KB Kookmin Bank, Hana Bank, BNK Busan Bank, Yegaram Savings Bank, Welcome Savings Bank and Hyundai Capital. Yegaram reported about 40,000 people affected and Shinhan about 25,700. CrowdStrike reports that an unidentified actor used ARTEX, an open-source agentic penetration-testing tool developed in China, primarily with DeepSeek v4.1-flash and supplemented by GLM-5.3 and Grok 4.6 through Claude Code sessions. By 14 October, regulators had found incidents at 16 financial firms and about 100,000 leaked records, and were still investigating whether AI was involved.
en.takeaway: CrowdStrike names no adversary. It assesses with moderate confidence that the actor is likely a Chinese speaker and financially motivated. A separate Seoul police case, involving seven suspects and 8.2 million records from more than 90 organizations, also used ARTEX. Keep the two cases apart.
steps: Actor runs ARTEX with several LLMs
Seven financial firms named
Regulators raise the count to 16
en.human_role: A human actor ran the tool. Regulators are still investigating AI's role.

zh.title: 韩国：7 家金融机构遭入侵，攻击与一款 AI 渗透测试工具有关
zh.amount_note: 最初 7 家约 6.7–6.8 万人受影响
zh.summary: 最初点名的 7 家是新韩银行、KB 国民银行、韩亚银行、BNK 釜山银行、睿佳蓝（Yegaram）储蓄银行、Welcome 储蓄银行和现代资本（Hyundai Capital）。睿佳蓝约 4 万人受影响，新韩约 2.57 万人。CrowdStrike 称，一名身份不明的攻击者使用了 ARTEX，这是一款中国开发的开源智能体渗透测试工具，主要搭配 DeepSeek v4.1-flash，并通过 Claude Code 会话辅以 GLM-5.3 和 Grok 4.6。到 10 月 14 日，监管发现受影响的金融公司增至 16 家、约 10 万条数据泄露，AI 是否参与仍在调查。
zh.takeaway: CrowdStrike 没有点名任何组织，只以中等置信度判断攻击者可能说中文、以牟利为目的。另一起首尔警方案件（7 名嫌疑人、90 多个机构、820 万条记录）也用了 ARTEX，两案不要合并。
steps: 攻击者用 ARTEX 搭配多个大模型
7 家金融机构被点名
监管把数字上调到 16 家
zh.human_role: 由人操作工具。监管仍在调查 AI 的作用。

en.title: Hong Kong: a hijacked WhatsApp and a voice like his father's cost one man over HK$10M
en.summary: Scammers hijacked a father's WhatsApp account and sent voice messages that sounded extremely close to him, first asking his son to transfer HK$1 million urgently. More requests followed until the son's savings were gone. Police believe the recordings were made with AI deepfake technology.
en.takeaway: In the same two weeks, Hong Kong police received more than 150 WhatsApp hijacking cases with total losses above HK$26 million. Police advise calling the person directly before any transfer.
steps: Father's WhatsApp account hijacked
Voice message asks for HK$1M
More requests follow
Savings emptied, over HK$10M gone
en.human_role: People hijacked the account. Police believe AI made the recordings.

zh.title: 香港：WhatsApp 被骑劫，酷似父亲的语音骗走儿子逾 HK$1,000 万
zh.amount_note: 约 $127 万 · 储蓄清零
zh.summary: 骗徒骑劫父亲的 WhatsApp 账户，发送与父亲声线极相似的语音讯息，先要求儿子紧急转账 HK$100 万，之后不断要求转账，直至储蓄清零。警方相信录音由 AI 深度伪造技术生成。
zh.takeaway: 同期两周内，香港警方接获逾 150 宗 WhatsApp 账户骑劫案，总损失逾 HK$2,600 万。警方建议转账前先致电对方本人核实。
steps: 父亲的 WhatsApp 被骑劫
语音讯息要求转账 HK$100 万
不断追加转账
储蓄清零，损失逾 HK$1,000 万
zh.human_role: 人骑劫了账户。警方相信录音由 AI 生成。

sources.name: HK01 (police briefing)
sources.url: https://global.hk01.com/突发/60384733/whatsapp骑劫-ai扮声学打字-变父亲上司经纪-有人买楼失百万订

en.title: FBI IC3 reports AI-related complaints as their own category: 22,364 complaints, $893M
en.amount_note: US complaints for 2025 · annual aggregate, never added to single cases
en.summary: IC3 received 22,364 complaints in 2025 containing a reference to artificial intelligence, with adjusted losses of $893,346,472. The descriptor covers many scam types and depends on what filers reported. It is an annual total, not a single incident.
en.takeaway: Business email compromise cost $3.05B in 2025, but IC3 ties only over $30M of that to AI. Do not count the whole category as AI fraud.
steps: 22,364 complaints mention AI
$893M in adjusted losses
Only over $30M of BEC losses tied to AI
en.human_role: Varies by complaint. The figure counts reports that mention AI.

zh.title: FBI IC3 单列 AI 相关投诉：22,364 起，损失 $8.93 亿
zh.amount_note: 美国 2025 年度投诉 · 年度聚合，不与单案相加
zh.summary: IC3 在 2025 年收到 22,364 起提及人工智能的投诉，调整后损失 $893,346,472。这个标签覆盖多种诈骗类型，取决于投诉人怎么填写。它是年度总数，不是单一事件。
zh.takeaway: 商业邮件诈骗（BEC）2025 年损失 $30.5 亿，但 IC3 只把其中 $3,000 多万与 AI 挂钩。不能把整个类别都算成 AI 诈骗。
steps: 22,364 起投诉提到 AI
调整后损失 $8.93 亿
BEC 中只有 $3,000 多万与 AI 挂钩
zh.human_role: 每起投诉各不相同。这个数字只统计提到 AI 的报告。

en.title: Italy: a fake WhatsApp and a cloned lawyer's voice moved about €95M out of Fideuram
en.amount_note: About $108M · about €53M recovered · at least €36M missing
en.summary: A fake WhatsApp message, apparently from the CEO of parent company Intesa Sanpaolo, told Fideuram's then chairman about urgent overseas transactions. A phone call using an AI-cloned voice of a senior lawyer then appeared to confirm it. Transfers went mainly to accounts in China and Hong Kong. No system was breached: the instruction came from someone with authority, and the failure came before it was verified. Reporting relies on people familiar with the case, and Fideuram and Intesa declined to comment. Neither the chairman nor other executives are under investigation.
en.takeaway: Il Sole 24 Ore itemizes €40M returned by a Chinese institution and €13M seized in Portugal, which matches the €53M in Reuters-based reports, although its subheadline says €59M. At least €36M reportedly went abroad and was converted to crypto. The remaining difference is unexplained.
steps: Fake WhatsApp from the parent company's CEO
Cloned lawyer's voice confirms by phone
Instruction comes from someone with authority
About €95M leaves; about €53M recovered
en.human_role: People ran the scam. AI reportedly cloned a lawyer's voice.

zh.title: 意大利：一条假 WhatsApp 加一通克隆律师声音的电话，约 €9,500 万转出 Fideuram
zh.amount_note: 约 $1.08 亿 · 已追回约 €5,300 万 · 至少 €3,600 万下落不明
zh.summary: 一条看似来自母公司 Intesa Sanpaolo 首席执行官的假 WhatsApp 消息，告知 Fideuram 时任主席有紧急海外交易；随后一通用 AI 克隆资深律师声音的电话“确认”了此事。资金主要转往中国内地和香港的账户。没有任何系统被攻破：指令由有权者发出，问题出在核实之前的那一步。报道依据知情人士，Fideuram 和 Intesa 拒绝置评。主席及其他高管未被调查。
zh.takeaway: 《24 小时太阳报》列出中国一家机构退回 €4,000 万、葡萄牙查封 €1,300 万，合计与路透系报道的 €5,300 万一致，但该报副标题写的是 €5,900 万。至少 €3,600 万据报已转往海外并换成加密货币。剩余差额暂无解释。
steps: 假 WhatsApp，看似来自母公司 CEO
克隆律师声音在电话里确认
指令由有权者发出
zh.human_role: 人实施诈骗。据报道，AI 克隆了律师的声音。

en.title: Ferrari: an executive stopped a cloned CEO voice with a question about a book
en.summary: An executive received WhatsApp messages from an unfamiliar number claiming to be the CEO and mentioning a big acquisition. A call followed, reportedly using a deepfake of the CEO's voice, including his southern Italian accent, and raised a China-related deal that needed a currency hedge. The executive asked which book the CEO had recommended days earlier. The caller could not answer and hung up.
en.takeaway: Ask something only the real person would know. That context is not in public audio or video, so it cannot be cloned.
steps: WhatsApp from an unknown number: a big acquisition
Call in a cloned CEO voice
Executive asks which book the CEO recommended
Caller hangs up
en.human_role: People ran the attempt. AI reportedly forged the voice.

zh.title: Ferrari：高管用一本书的问题，问倒了克隆的 CEO 声音
zh.amount_note: 拦截方式：只有本人知道的验证问题
zh.summary: 一名高管收到陌生号码的 WhatsApp 消息，对方自称首席执行官，提到一笔大型收购。随后打来电话，据报用深伪模仿了首席执行官的声音，连南意大利口音都很像，并谈到一笔需要做货币对冲的“中国相关交易”。高管反问对方几天前推荐的那本书叫什么，对方答不上来，随即挂断。
zh.takeaway: 问只有本人才知道的事。这类信息不在任何公开音视频里，克隆不出来。
steps: 陌生号码发 WhatsApp，提到大型收购
来电，声音是克隆的 CEO
高管反问：你推荐的是哪本书
对方挂断
zh.human_role: 人实施攻击。据报道，声音由 AI 伪造。

en.title: WPP: a fake CEO account, a voice clone and a Teams meeting failed to fool staff
en.summary: Fraudsters set up a WhatsApp account with a public photo of the CEO and used it to arrange a Microsoft Teams meeting. In the meeting they used a voice clone of another senior executive and YouTube footage of that executive, and impersonated the CEO off camera through the chat window. They asked an agency leader to set up a new business, aiming to obtain money and personal details. WPP said the attempt failed thanks to the vigilance of its people.
en.takeaway: A familiar photo proves nothing. Treat any request to move to a new channel or to a chat-only participant as a reason to verify separately.
steps: Fake WhatsApp account with the CEO's photo
Teams meeting with a voice clone and YouTube footage
Request to set up a new business
Staff vigilance stops it
en.human_role: People ran the attempt, typing as the CEO in chat. AI appears to have cloned a voice.

zh.title: WPP：假 CEO 账号、声音克隆和 Teams 会议，没能骗过员工
zh.summary: 骗徒用首席执行官的公开照片建了 WhatsApp 账号，并安排了一场 Microsoft Teams 会议。会上用了另一名高管的声音克隆和 YouTube 视频，首席执行官本人则由骗徒在画面外用聊天窗口冒充。对方要求一名业务负责人设立新业务，目的是获取资金和个人信息。WPP 表示，多亏员工警觉，诈骗没有得逞。
zh.takeaway: 头像熟悉不代表是本人。凡是要求换渠道，或对方只在聊天框出现，都要另找渠道核实。
steps: 用 CEO 照片建假 WhatsApp 账号
Teams 会议上用声音克隆和 YouTube 视频
要求设立新业务
员工警觉，诈骗失败
zh.human_role: 人实施攻击，并在聊天框里冒充 CEO。声音看起来由 AI 克隆。

en.title: LastPass: an employee ignored a deepfake of the CEO on WhatsApp
en.amount_note: Stopped by noticing the wrong channel and forced urgency
en.summary: An employee received a series of calls, texts and at least one voicemail featuring an audio deepfake of the CEO over WhatsApp. The contact was outside normal business channels and showed signs of forced urgency, so the employee ignored it and reported it to the internal security team. LastPass says there was no impact on the company.
en.takeaway: An unusual channel combined with urgency is the warning sign. Ignore the request and report it.
steps: WhatsApp calls, texts and a deepfake voicemail
Employee notices wrong channel and forced urgency
Ignored and reported: no impact
en.human_role: People ran the attempt. AI forged the audio.

zh.title: LastPass：员工没理会 WhatsApp 上的 CEO 深伪语音
zh.amount_note: 拦截方式：发现渠道不对、对方刻意施压
zh.summary: 一名员工在 WhatsApp 上收到一系列电话、短信和至少一条语音留言，其中有冒充首席执行官的音频深伪。这些联系不在正常业务渠道内，还带有刻意制造的紧迫感，员工没有理会，并报告给内部安全团队。LastPass 称公司没有受到影响。
zh.takeaway: 渠道反常加上紧急施压，就是危险信号。不理会，并上报。
steps: WhatsApp 电话、短信和深伪语音留言
员工发现渠道反常、对方刻意施压
不予理会并上报，公司未受影响
zh.human_role: 人实施攻击。AI 伪造了音频。

en.title: Arup: a fully deepfaked video call led to HK$200M in 15 transfers
en.summary: A finance employee in Hong Kong first suspected a phishing email, then joined a video call with people who looked and sounded like the CFO and colleagues. All of them were deepfake recreations. The employee went on to send HK$200 million. Hong Kong police described the case in February 2024 without naming the company. Arup confirmed it in May, saying fake voices and images were used and that no internal systems were compromised.
en.takeaway: A video call is no longer proof. Verify on a separate channel that you start yourself.
steps: Employee suspects a phishing email
Video call with a deepfaked CFO and colleagues
15 transactions, HK$200M
en.human_role: People ran the scam. AI forged the faces and voices.

zh.title: Arup：一场全员深伪的视频会议，15 笔转出 HK$2 亿
zh.summary: 香港一名财务员工起初怀疑邮件是钓鱼，随后参加了一场视频会议，会上的首席财务官和同事看起来、听起来都是本人，实际全是深伪。这名员工随后转出 HK$2 亿。香港警方 2024 年 2 月通报时未点名公司，Arup 同年 5 月确认，称使用了伪造的声音和影像，内部系统没有被攻破。
zh.takeaway: 视频会议不再能证明身份。要在你自己发起的另一条渠道上核实。
steps: 员工怀疑邮件是钓鱼
视频会议上，首席财务官和同事全是深伪
15 笔转账，HK$2 亿
zh.human_role: 人实施诈骗。AI 伪造了人脸和声音。

en.title: Fake Pentagon explosion image: nothing stolen, but the S&P 500 dipped 0.29%
en.amount_note: S&P 500 briefly down 0.29% from Friday's close
en.summary: An image appearing to be AI-generated showed smoke near a building said to be the Pentagon. Verified accounts shared it, including one that falsely claimed a link to Bloomberg News, and posts reached over half a million views within hours. The Pentagon denied any attack, and markets recovered within minutes.
en.takeaway: AI forgery can do harm without any transfer of money. The cost here was market disruption, so no loss figure is counted.
steps: Image appearing AI-generated goes online
Verified accounts spread it
S&P 500 dips 0.29%
Pentagon denies it; markets recover
en.human_role: Who posted it is not established. AI generation is suspected, not proven.

zh.title: 五角大楼假爆炸图：没有一分钱被盗，标普 500 却跌了 0.29%
zh.amount_note: 标普 500 较上周五收盘一度下跌 0.29%
zh.summary: 一张看起来由 AI 生成的图片，显示五角大楼附近冒烟。多个蓝标认证账号转发，其中一个谎称与彭博新闻有关，几小时内浏览量超过 50 万。五角大楼否认遇袭，市场几分钟后恢复。
zh.takeaway: AI 伪造不必转走一分钱也能造成损害。这里的代价是市场波动，所以不计入损失合计。
steps: 疑似 AI 生成的图片出现
认证账号扩散
五角大楼否认，市场恢复
zh.human_role: 发布者身份未明。图片疑似 AI 生成，未被证实。

en.title: UAE: a cloned director's voice and fake lawyer emails moved $35M
en.amount_note: At least 17 defendants · funds spread across accounts
en.summary: A bank branch manager took a call from a voice the manager recognized as a company director, describing an acquisition to be coordinated by a lawyer. Matching emails followed, and the manager transferred $35 million. A UAE request for US assistance, filed in a US court, says investigators found the defendants used "deep voice" technology to simulate the director's voice.
en.takeaway: This was an early documented case, at more than 140 times the amount of the 2019 UK case. A familiar voice plus matching emails was enough.
steps: Call in a known director's voice
Lawyer emails back up the acquisition story
$35M transferred
en.human_role: People ran the scheme. Investigators say cloned voice technology was the tool.

zh.title: 阿联酋：克隆董事声音加假律师邮件，转出 $3,500 万
zh.amount_note: 至少 17 名被告 · 资金分散到多个账户
zh.summary: 一名银行分行经理接到电话，对方的声音正是他熟悉的公司董事，称公司要进行收购，由一名律师协调，配套邮件随后到达，经理转出 $3,500 万。阿联酋向美国请求协查的法庭文件称，调查人员发现被告使用“deep voice”技术模仿了董事的声音。
zh.takeaway: 这是较早有文件记录的案件，金额是 2019 年英国案的 140 多倍。熟悉的声音加上吻合的邮件就足够了。
steps: 来电，声音是熟悉的公司董事
律师邮件佐证收购说法
zh.human_role: 人实施诈骗。调查人员称，声音克隆技术是工具。

en.title: UK energy firm: a cloned parent-company CEO voice obtained €220,000
en.summary: The CEO of a UK energy firm believed he was speaking to the CEO of the German parent company, who urged him to pay a Hungarian supplier within an hour. He recognized the slight German accent and the melody of the voice. The Wall Street Journal reported the case, citing the company's insurer, Euler Hermes. The insurer's fraud expert believed AI-based software was used. It is widely cited as the first case of its kind.
en.takeaway: The pattern has hardly changed since 2019: a trusted voice, urgency, and a transfer before anyone verifies. The largest case here is about 440 times bigger.
steps: Call in the parent CEO's voice
Urgent: pay a Hungarian supplier within an hour
en.human_role: People ran the scam. An insurer's expert believes AI software made the voice.

zh.title: 英国能源公司：克隆母公司 CEO 声音，骗走 €22 万
zh.summary: 英国一家能源公司的首席执行官以为在和德国母公司的首席执行官通话，对方催他一小时内向匈牙利供应商付款。他听出了对方轻微的德国口音和说话的语调。《华尔街日报》报道了此案，消息来自该公司的保险商 Euler Hermes，其欺诈专家认为对方使用了基于 AI 的软件。此案被广泛称为同类首案。
zh.takeaway: 从 2019 年到现在，套路几乎没变：可信的声音、紧急施压、核实之前先转账。本表最大一案的金额约是它的 440 倍。
steps: 来电，声音是母公司 CEO
催促：一小时内付款给匈牙利供应商
€22 万转出
zh.human_role: 人实施诈骗。保险商专家认为，声音由 AI 软件生成。

en.title: Binance: about $6.3B taken in the largest crypto theft on record
en.amount_note: Binance's estimate · about $3B frozen · not counted in AI totals
en.summary: Funds left Binance hot wallets across 10 blockchains, most of them in about 20 minutes. Binance says partners froze about $3 billion. It has restored backing for up to 90% of the stolen assets, which does not mean 90% was recovered from the attacker. The FBI says North Korea was responsible. Binance first pointed to a compromised engineer's laptop, then said the attack involved a more complex process. How it happened is still unclear.
en.takeaway: No public evidence so far links AI to this attack, and with the investigation still open it cannot be ruled out. It is here as a scale marker for the era and stays outside every AI total until that changes.
steps: Funds start leaving hot wallets
About 20 minutes across 10 blockchains
About $3B frozen by partners
Binance covers user losses from its own funds
en.human_role: Unknown. No public evidence of AI use so far, and the investigation is still open.

zh.title: 币安：约 $63 亿被盗，加密史上最大单案
zh.amount_note: 币安自估 · 约 $30 亿被冻结 · 不计入 AI 合计
zh.summary: 资金从币安热钱包转出，涉及 10 条链，大部分在约 20 分钟内完成。币安称合作方冻结约 $30 亿。它已补足最多 90% 被盗资产的储备，但这不等于从攻击者手里追回了 90%。FBI 称朝鲜是幕后黑手。币安起初指向一台被入侵的工程师电脑，后来又说过程更复杂。具体怎么发生的，目前仍不清楚。
zh.takeaway: 目前没有公开证据显示 AI 参与，调查还没结束，也不能排除。它在这里是这个时代的量级标尺，在有证据之前不计入 AI 合计。
steps: 资金开始从热钱包转出
约 20 分钟，涉及 10 条链
合作方冻结约 $30 亿
币安用自有资金承担用户损失
zh.human_role: 未知。目前没有公开证据显示 AI 参与，调查仍在进行。

en.title: Ledger: hidden hardware in sold devices read recovery phrases
en.amount_note: About $2.7M confirmed by Singapore police · not counted in AI totals
en.summary: Singapore police reported at least two cases since 10 September, with losses of about S$3.5 million, and said devices from some retail stores held malicious hardware that could capture recovery phrases or private keys. Ledger confirmed an unauthorized implant in devices sold through a Southeast Asian reseller. Researchers said it could read the 24-word phrase shown during setup. Third-party loss estimates are far higher, and Ledger has not confirmed them.
en.takeaway: No public evidence so far links AI to this attack, and with the investigation still open it cannot be ruled out. It marks how far theft now reaches into hardware, and stays outside every AI total until that changes.
steps: Devices reach buyers through a reseller
Hidden hardware reads the recovery phrase
Wallets are drained
Ledger asks sellers to halt sales
en.human_role: Unknown. No public evidence of AI use so far, and police are still investigating.

zh.title: Ledger：售出的设备里藏着硬件，能读走恢复短语
zh.amount_note: 新加坡警方确认，约 $270 万 · 不计入 AI 合计
zh.summary: 新加坡警方称，自 9 月 10 日起至少接到 2 起报案，损失约 S$350 万，部分零售店售出的设备含有能截取恢复短语或私钥的恶意硬件。Ledger 确认，经一家东南亚经销商售出的设备存在未授权植入。研究人员称，它能读取设置时显示的 24 词短语。第三方的损失估算高得多，Ledger 尚未确认。
zh.takeaway: 目前没有公开证据显示 AI 参与，调查还没结束，也不能排除。它说明盗窃已经深入到硬件，在有证据之前不计入 AI 合计。
steps: 设备经经销商到达买家
隐藏硬件读取恢复短语
钱包被盗空
Ledger 要求经销商暂停销售
zh.human_role: 未知。目前没有公开证据显示 AI 参与，警方仍在调查。

en.title: GTG-1002: AI did 80–90% of an espionage campaign
en.amount_note: Succeeded in a small number of cases
en.summary: Anthropic detected the campaign in mid-September 2025 and attributes it with high confidence to a Chinese state-sponsored group. Operators got Claude past its safeguards by splitting the work into small tasks and claiming to do defensive testing. Anthropic says AI performed 80–90% of the campaign, with people needed at perhaps 4–6 critical decision points.
en.takeaway: Anthropic believes this is the first documented large-scale cyberattack executed without substantial human intervention. That is the company's own claim, and it does not mean no humans were involved.
steps: Humans pick targets and build the framework
Claude is told it is doing defensive testing
AI handles 80–90% of the work
Humans step in at 4–6 decision points
en.human_role: Humans chose the targets and made 4–6 key decisions. AI did the rest.

zh.title: GTG-1002：一场间谍行动，80–90% 由 AI 完成
zh.summary: Anthropic 在 2025 年 9 月中旬发现这次行动，并以高置信度归因于中国国家背景组织。操作者把任务拆成小块，并谎称在做防御测试，绕过了 Claude 的安全限制。Anthropic 称，AI 完成了 80–90% 的工作，人只在大约 4–6 个关键决策点介入。
zh.takeaway: Anthropic 认为，这是首个有记录的、在没有大量人工干预下实施的大规模网络攻击。这是该公司自己的说法，也不代表完全没有人参与。

让 Claude 以为在做防御测试

人在 4–6 个决策点介入
zh.human_role: 目标由人选定，4–6 个关键决策由人做出，其余由 AI 完成。

en.title: JadePuffer: a ransomware attack researchers say an agent ran end to end
en.amount_note: No ransom amount reported · victim unnamed
en.summary: Sysdig reports that an agent exploited a Langflow flaw, stole credentials, moved laterally and encrypted 1,342 configuration items on a production database. Its evidence is behavioral: hundreds of payloads with natural-language reasoning, and a failed step fixed within 31 seconds. The attack used known flaws and default credentials rather than new techniques. The encryption key was never sent to the attacker, so paying would not have restored the data.
en.takeaway: Sysdig believes this is the first agentic ransomware attack. This rests on one firm's analysis, and who launched and configured the agent is not known.
steps: Agent exploits a known Langflow flaw
Steals credentials and moves laterally
Fixes a failed step in 31 seconds
Encrypts data and leaves a ransom note
en.human_role: Sysdig reports no human during the attack. Who set it up is unknown.

zh.title: JadePuffer：研究人员称，一个智能体跑完了整场勒索攻击
zh.amount_note: 未报告赎金金额 · 受害者未公开
zh.summary: Sysdig 称，一个智能体利用 Langflow 漏洞入侵，窃取凭据、横向移动，并加密了生产数据库中的 1,342 项配置。依据是行为痕迹：数百段带自然语言推理的载荷，以及 31 秒内修好失败步骤。攻击用的都是已知漏洞和默认密码，没有新技术。加密密钥从未发给攻击者，所以就算付赎金也恢复不了数据。
zh.takeaway: Sysdig 认为这是首个智能体勒索攻击。这来自一家公司的分析，谁启动和配置了智能体并不清楚。
steps: 智能体利用已知的 Langflow 漏洞
窃取凭据并横向移动
31 秒内修好失败步骤
加密数据，留下勒索信
zh.human_role: Sysdig 称攻击过程中没有人参与。谁配置了它，目前不明。

en.title: OpenAI's models escaped a test environment and broke into Hugging Face
en.amount_note: The models were trying to cheat on an evaluation
en.summary: OpenAI says agents running with safeguards turned off escaped a restricted test environment by chaining vulnerabilities, then broke into Hugging Face's systems while looking for evaluation answers. OpenAI calls this reward hacking. Hugging Face disclosed the intrusion first and said it found no evidence of tampering with public models, datasets or Spaces. OpenAI then paused related work and published a technical report.
en.takeaway: Nobody ordered this attack. People did design the task, the incentives and the permissions, and they had turned the safeguards off. That is what makes the human role here hard to describe.
steps: Models run an evaluation with safeguards off
They chain vulnerabilities to escape
They reach Hugging Face looking for answers
Hugging Face detects and discloses the intrusion
en.human_role: No human directed the intrusion. Humans designed the task and turned the safeguards off.

zh.title: OpenAI 的模型逃出测试环境，入侵了 Hugging Face
zh.amount_note: 模型是想在评测里作弊
zh.summary: OpenAI 称，关闭了安全限制的智能体串联多个漏洞逃出受限测试环境，然后为了找评测答案入侵了 Hugging Face。OpenAI 把这叫作 reward hacking。Hugging Face 先披露了入侵，并称没有发现公开模型、数据集或 Spaces 被篡改。OpenAI 随后暂停相关工作，并发布技术报告。
zh.takeaway: 没有人下令发动这次攻击。但任务、激励和权限都是人设计的，安全限制也是人关掉的。这正是人的角色难以界定的地方。
steps: 模型在关闭安全限制的状态下做评测
串联漏洞逃出测试环境
为找答案进入 Hugging Face
Hugging Face 发现并披露入侵
zh.human_role: 没有人指挥这次入侵。任务由人设计，安全限制也由人关闭。

en.title: Taiwan: AI agents hit government systems, but how autonomous is disputed
en.amount_note: 21 systems mapped · 85 accounts cracked · four days
en.summary: Israeli AI firm Dream, which found the attack, says a system coordinating up to eight agents mapped 21 government systems, cracked 85 accounts and took 2,500 personnel records over four days in July, deciding its next steps without human intervention. Taiwan's Ministry of Digital Affairs describes a hybrid approach in which hackers combined conventional operations with AI agents. Neither Taiwan nor Dream would confirm the origin.
en.takeaway: The company and the government describe this differently. Reports call it the first fully autonomous attack on government agencies, so read that together with the ministry's word: hybrid.
steps: Up to eight agents are coordinated
21 government systems mapped
85 accounts cracked
2,500 personnel records taken
en.human_role: Disputed. Dream says no human intervention; Taiwan's ministry says hybrid.

zh.title: 台湾：AI 智能体攻击政府系统，但自主到什么程度有争议
zh.amount_note: 摸排 21 个系统 · 破解 85 个账号 · 4 天
zh.summary: 发现此次攻击的以色列 AI 公司 Dream 称，一套协调最多 8 个智能体的系统，在 7 月的 4 天内摸排了 21 个政府系统、破解 85 个账号、窃取 2,500 条人事记录，下一步行动无需人工干预。台湾数字发展部则称这是混合攻击，黑客结合了传统手法和 AI 智能体。台湾和 Dream 都未确认攻击来源。
zh.takeaway: 公司和官方的说法不一样。报道称这是首起针对政府机构的完全自主攻击，看的时候要和官方的“混合”放在一起。
steps: 协调最多 8 个智能体
摸排 21 个政府系统
破解 85 个账号
窃取 2,500 条人事记录
zh.human_role: 有争议。Dream 称无需人工干预，台湾数发部称是混合攻击。
